risks_and_mitigations.description: Cloudflare CDN proxies only HTTP/HTTPS and TCP/WebSocket traffic; it drops arbitrary UDP packets. If LiveKit or Janus RTC media is routed through Cloudflare proxied DNS, all peer-to-peer audio/video fails.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Media plane UDP (50000-50100 for LiveKit, 20000-20100 for Janus) must route directly to VPS IP 36.50.27.240. Cloudflare DNS for rtc-staging.histolab.icu must be configured as DNS-only (grey cloud).

risks_and_mitigations.description: Production nginx-lms.conf hardcodes static upstream hostnames without variables, creating startup dependency on upstream container readiness, and uses deprecated listen http2 syntax.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Align production config with staging pattern using dynamic resolver 127.0.0.11 and variables ($api_upstream, etc.) with 'http2 on;' directive.

risks_and_mitigations.description: Documentation in STAGING_DEPLOYMENT_SPEC.md claims live_ai_active_sessions, live_ai_audio_minutes_total, and live_ai_token_expenditure_total exist as Prometheus metrics, but they are not implemented in backend-rust/src/routes/metrics.rs.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Flagged as DOCS_ONLY_UNMEASURED in baseline artifact. Prometheus scraper must not alert on missing AI session metrics until native gauges are added.

risks_and_mitigations.description: Generic specs refer to /ready, but no /ready route is exposed in the gateway. Operators or k8s ingresses probing /ready receive 404.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Documented /api/v1/internal/db-health as the authoritative DB readiness probe in runbooks.
